mapper.sql: USER_ID, USER_NAME as NAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD, active(IS_ACTIVE) as IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, EDITOR_USER_ID, role(USER_TYPE) as USER_TYPE
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.email, role(u.user_type) as user_type, active(u.is_active) as is_active, g.group_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN group_members gm ON u.user_id = gm.user_id AND gm.is_active = 'O1' LEFT JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.group_id ORDER BY u.user_id desc

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, g.group_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN group_members gm ON u.user_id = gm.user_id AND gm.is_active = 'O1' AND gm.is_primary = 'Y' AND u.is_active='O1' LEFT JOIN groups g ON gm.group_id = g.group_id ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name as name, u.password, u.email, role(u.user_type) as user_type, active(u.is_active) as is_active, gm.group_id as primary_group_id FROM users u LEFT JOIN group_members gm ON u.user_id = gm.user_id AND gm.is_active = 'O1' AND gm.is_primary='Y' WHERE u.user_id=#{id}
